title: Service Engineer - Karnataka
jobDescription:
Vestas is the major leader in wind technology and a driving force in the development of the wind power industry. Vestas' core business comprises the development, manufacture, sale, marketing, and maintenance of Wind Turbines. Come and join us at Vestas! Service Asia > Service Operation South > Karnataka 1 Customer Service Department handles Post-sales Service Operations to meet the contractual obligations with customers Responsibilities
- Follow the high level of safety culture and standards as per company requirements
- Attend to break down maintenance on call; ensure WTG's and related equipment's are maintained in neat and technically acceptable conditions according to standard engineering practices
- Document the work done indicating consumption of spares/ consumables, list further actions along with targeted completion dates
- Report abnormalities and take corrective action in consultation with the Supervisors
- Keep up to date with all operating/ maintenance manuals, checklists, service bulletins, etc. applicable to the WTG and associated equipment, carry out servicing activities as per the latest certified checklists, manuals and service bulletins
- Ensure safety and care of all tools, tackles, measuring instruments and spare parts in custody
- Comply with all HSE / ISO & all other statutory requirements
- Ensure office and guest house are maintained in good condition and monitor the performance of security personnel/ operators, report non-compliances
- Assist in the sub-assembly of WTG components at the factory premises whenever required
- Rectification of Mechanical, Electrical and hydraulic Break Downs of the Wind Turbines
- Analyzing the performance of the turbines and Preparing performance Reports
- Major work like Blade, Gearbox, Generator and main shaft replacement added advantage
- Experience in Unit substation maintenance and rectification of Unit sub-station related breakdown added advantage
- Knowledge in SAP S/4HANA added advantage
- Knowledge in basics of Computer, MS-Excel, MS-Word and Power BI Qualifications
- Diploma or Degree
- Mechanical, Electrical or Electronics
- Minimum 3 to 6 years working experience in Wind turbine Generator
- Good communication in English / Kannada is must and Hindi is additional advantage Competencies
- Willingness to promote Vestas commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging
- Ability to read, comprehend and write in English
- Ability to climb stairs and ladders 60-150 meters in height
- Ability to effectively participate in all training courses, including high-angle rescue
- Able to work in demanding physical and inclement weather conditions
- Comfortable working remotely with limited supervisory interaction
- Should be Flexible as the position requires travelling and unplanned overtime may occur What We Offer Vestas provides an open, respectful, and global culture, an attractive compensation package, and long-term career development. We care and respect all employees and will offer: On the job training, A ideal platform for professional and personal development, Bonus Program &, etc. In return, we expect you to go the extra mile to achieve results. title: Inventory count analyst
jobDescription:
Vestas is the world leader in wind technology and a driving-force in the development of the wind power industry. Vestas' core business comprises the development, manufacture, sale, marketing, and maintenance of Wind Turbines. Come and join us at Vestas! Vestas Technology & Operations > Supply Chain > Regional SC partner MED We are the highly established Service Supply Chain business partners, aiming to improve processes efficiencies, it's performance measures and master data quality. Together we are enabling stakeholder's policy making by providing regular and on-demand business intelligence for the functions across SC and Service operations. Responsibilities
- Schedule and plan for the Yearly Stock count in coordination with the regions
- Oversee inventory and supply chain management according to company guidelines
- Perform critical inventory tasks in IM and WM system to ensure the correct amount of items are in stock
- Investigate and correct discrepancies in reported quantities and locations of all inventory
- Track rates of accuracy to Plan and Schedule Different Stock Counts in align with Finance
- Review documentation and monitor product codes to search for discrepancies; troubleshoot quantity discrepancies between stock and records
- Develop and implement improvements to existing operational procedures in order to maximize efficiency and cut operations costs
- Prepare, generate and file financial inventory reports; review reports monthly with management
- Coordinate with regional responsible for completing the scheduled counts on time within SLA Qualifications
- 2 to 5 years experience with knowledge in inventory stock count and cycle count activities
- Minimum 1 year of experience working in warehouse
- Graduation in Engineering or similar or PG in SCM
- Proficient with Microsoft Excel/Power Point
- Knowledge in SQL and Excel Macros (optional)
- Experience with ERP-(SAP) system Competencies
- Good communication skills in English both written and oral
- Good analytical skill and knowledge on Warehouse and inventory basics
- Flexible regarding work hours due to warehouses in Europe and US Countries
- Structured and organized
- Outgoing and polite towards our stakeholders
- A good team player
- Proactive and self-driven

jobDescription:

Vestas' core business comprises of Development, Manufacturing, Sales, Marketing and Service of Wind Turbines. Come and Join us at Vestas! Vestas Technology & Operations > Manufacturing > Blades PE Finish & Paint Come join the new Vestas Blades Process Engineering organization. The Finish & Paint Blades Tooling department within the Blades Finish & Paint Process Engineering are Responsible for tooling development, requirements and specifications. The function will also support the supplier management and development. Service and maintenance strategy, is also within their scope together with OOE and TPM. There will be between 2-4 tooling engineers working with Finish & paint Manufacturing tooling. The whole Finish & Paint department will consist of 9-12 high educated engineers or equal education, and they will be divided into 5 teams: Process, Tooling, Documentation, Operational Support and Training. Responsibilities
- As a Tooling Engineer at Vestas, you will play a key role in defining the Requirements and specifications for tools used in the Finish & Paint process, in the blades building process. If you do not have a deep knowledge within composite materials, you will have a high motivation to get it. You will have a clear focus on tools needed for modern production process technologies, to ensure high process stability and efficiency and thereby to improve overall business performance and Safety Quality Delivery and Cost (SQDC)
- Design, and optimizing tools for the Finish & Paint processes.
- Tool development, Tooling requirements and specifications
- Tool industrialization and standardization
- Create tooling and supplier roadmap via analysis of AS IS and future state
- Supplier management, CAPEX Budget and Tool Delivery (TPM)
- Service and maintenance strategy including EAM
- Tool optimization including tool in use today
- Be part of building a culture of excellence, innovation, and accountability
- Use digital tools like digital twins and data analytics to improve performance and make data-driven decisions.
- Investigating and solving production issues using structured methods such as the 5x Whys, Fishbone Diagrams, and FMEA.
- Applying continuous improvement principles using quality tools like Statistical Process Control (SPC), Lean, Six Sigma, and Kaizen to reduce waste, improve efficiency, and ensure final product quality. Qualifications

- Identyfikowanie i zgłaszanie opóźnień lub odchyleń od standardowych procesów oraz udział w analizie przyczyn źródłowych

- Mile widziane doświadczenie w obszarze kontroli jakości lub w środowisku produkcyjnym
- Znajomość Standardowych Instrukcji Pracy (WI) oraz procedur zapewnienia jakości
- Podstawowa znajomość zasad Lean oraz metodologii 5S
- Umiejętność czytania i stosowania dokumentacji technicznej oraz instrukcji Kompetencje
- Dbałość o szczegóły i silne zaangażowanie w utrzymanie wysokich standardów
- Umiejętność skutecznej komunikacji oraz pracy zespołowej
- Proaktywne podejście i chęć udziału w usprawnianiu procesów
